skill.name: claude-code-guide
skill.description: Advanced Claude Code guide for tools, REPL workflows, MCP integration, hooks, troubleshooting, and best practices.
skill.summary: Learn practical Claude Code workflows, tool usage, MCP patterns, and safety-aware development habits.
skill.author: 2025Emma

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are markdown examples, path references, or sample scripts rather than executable package code. I confirmed two static concerns and added one semantic concern: privileged sudo automation, API key exposure, and shell eval in an example script. No prompt injection attempt or data-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Privileged command in automated recovery example
remediation.suggestion: Remove the sudo example or add a clear requirement for explicit human approval before privileged service restarts.

remediation.issue: API key troubleshooting prints the full secret
remediation.suggestion: Replace echo $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY with a presence check or masked output that cannot reveal the credential.

remediation.issue: Shell profiling example uses eval on arbitrary operation strings
remediation.suggestion: Use an allowlist or array-based command execution pattern, and document that eval must not receive untrusted input.

remediation.issue: Automation examples create executable hooks and scripts
remediation.suggestion: Add review guidance before enabling generated hooks, chmod changes, or recurring background automation.

content.value_statement: Developers need reliable ways to understand Claude Code tools and workflow patterns. This skill provides a structured guide for REPL use, MCP setup, hooks, task management, and troubleshooting.
actual_capabilities: Explains the main Claude Code tools and when to use them.
Shows REPL workflows for data analysis, algorithm testing, and file inspection.
Describes MCP configuration patterns and external tool integration concepts.
Outlines hook, slash command, and task management workflows.
Provides troubleshooting guidance for context, network, agent, and build issues.
Summarizes safety practices for permissions, secrets, and generated code review.
limitations: It is a documentation guide, not an automation runtime.
Some examples may lag current Claude Code behavior or official docs.
Advanced shell and hook examples require manual review before use.
The primary guide content is Chinese, so teams may need translation review.

use_cases.title: Learn Claude Code Basics
use_cases.description: Map each core tool to common development tasks and understand the default workflow options.

use_cases.title: Plan Advanced Development Workflows
use_cases.description: Design repeatable workflows for testing, code review, large-file analysis, and troubleshooting.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Team Automation Patterns
use_cases.description: Review MCP, hook, and background-task patterns before introducing them into a shared project.

prompt_templates.title: Explain the Toolset
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this guide to explain the main Claude Code tools. Include when to use each tool and one safe example workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Create a File Analysis Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this guide to plan a safe workflow for analyzing a large project file. Include discovery, sampling, and verification steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design an MCP Integration Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this guide to review an MCP integration plan. Identify required configuration, permissions, testing steps, and safety checks.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an Automation Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this guide to evaluate a proposed hook and background-task automation strategy. Flag risky commands, secret exposure, and approval points.

output_examples.input: I need a workflow for analyzing a large markdown guide.
output: Start with size and structure checks.
Sample the beginning, major sections, and ending.
Track assumptions and verify important claims before editing.

output_examples.input: I want to add MCP tools for a team project.
output: List the external systems and required permissions.
Test the server with limited scope before expanding access.

output_examples.input: I want a safer hook workflow for code formatting.
output: Use a narrow trigger for formatting changes.
Keep destructive commands out of automatic hooks.
Review logs and failures before enabling team-wide use.

best_practices: Treat shell, hook, and MCP examples as patterns that require local review.
Verify current Claude Code behavior against official documentation before rollout.
Keep secrets masked and outside shared memory, logs, and guide examples.
anti_patterns: Do not run privileged commands from examples without explicit approval.
Do not copy hook scripts into shared projects before security review.
Do not print API keys or secret values while troubleshooting.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps users understand Claude Code tools, workflows, MCP concepts, hooks, troubleshooting, and safety practices.

faq.question: Does it execute commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It is a documentation skill that explains workflows and examples.

faq.question: Is it useful for Codex users?
faq.answer: Yes. Codex users can use it to compare Claude Code concepts with similar coding-agent workflows.

faq.question: Does it replace official Claude documentation?
faq.answer: No. It should be used with current official documentation for final behavior and policy details.

faq.question: What should users review carefully?
faq.answer: Users should review examples involving sudo, hooks, MCP servers, hidden configuration files, and environment variables.

faq.question: Who benefits most from this guide?
faq.answer: Developers, team leads, and DevOps engineers who want structured Claude Code workflow guidance benefit most.
